description: This PHP file handles the deletion of a user in the vtiger CRM system. It retrieves user IDs from HTTP request parameters, invokes a method to transfer ownership and delete the user, and then redirects to the appropriate view based on whether the request was via AJAX or not.

classes.name: Users
classes.description: The Users class manages user-related functionalities, including user deletion and ownership transfer.

methods.name: transformOwnerShipAndDelete
methods.description: A method in the Users class that handles transferring ownership and deleting a user.
